name: experience-translate-rooms-api
deploymentNote: Experience Host service ID token専用の予約なしroom APIを含む合意契約。API→fencing relay→Experienceの固定SHA配備とstg受入まではHTTP flagをOFFに維持する。
scope: OWNER creates a translate room for a legacy NIHO booking or an Experience DB public booking UUID
room state, per-role joined/ready and usage minutes for the host screen's polling
OWNER creates/restores a standalone translate room without a booking
explicit per-seat invite reissue with old credentials revoked
excludedScope: relay tickets, relay URLs, JWKS or the public invite join endpoint
guest identity beyond a pseudonymous participantId
NIHO private implementation source or history
